title: Spodoptera frugiperda control trials in maize, one record per measured value
description: Fixed record format for every extractor. Output is a JSON array (or JSON Lines) of records that validate against this schema. Source PDFs and their record pages are listed in sources.json.
rules: One record per table cell that holds a measured value. A table with 5 treatments and 3 evaluation dates gives 15 records.

Copy every number exactly as printed. Put the printed text in value_as_printed and the number in value; the only allowed change is decimal comma to point (12,5 -> 12.5) and removing thousands separators (1.234,5 -> 1234.5).

Never compute, convert, round or infer a value. No averages across rows, no unit conversions, no Abbott correction, no values read off a chart by eye. If the paper does not print it, it does not go in.

Do not invent context. location, season_or_year, crop_stage, dose_and_unit, application_method, n_or_reps and statistic come from the document (table, caption, footnote or methods); when the document does not say, use null.

treatment and variable are copied as written in the document, in its language, including abbreviations. Standardized fields (treatment_type, variable_standardized) are the only place where the extractor classifies.

Text after the number in the same cell: significance letters go in significance_letter exactly as printed (e.g. 'a', 'ab', 'Ab1'); a dispersion term such as '± 0,5' or '(2,3)' goes in notes as printed.
Cells with '-', 'nd', 'ns' or blank are skipped, not recorded as 0. A printed 0 or 0,0 is a value and is recorded.

Figures: record values only when the figure prints the numbers (data labels on bars or points). If a figure has data that cannot be read exactly, write no records for it and list it in the extraction notes as skipped, with the page and figure number.
Untreated checks (testemunha) are recorded like any other treatment, with treatment_type 'control'.
page is the PDF page number counted from 1 (first page of the file = 1), not the number printed on the page.
table_or_figure is the label as printed ('Tabela 3', 'TABLE 2', 'Figura 1'). Text-only values are allowed when a number is stated in the body text; use 'text' and quote the sentence in notes.
When one column mixes several things (e.g. 'Dano/Produtividade'), split into separate records with the matching variable.

doc_id.description: Document id from sources.json (also the PDF file name without .pdf).

location.description: Municipality/state as written, e.g. 'Sete Lagoas, MG'. 'laboratório' or 'casa de vegetação' plus the place when it is a lab or greenhouse trial.

season_or_year.description: Season or year of the trial as written, e.g. '2015/2016', 'safrinha 2018', 'maio/2017'.

crop_stage.description: Crop stage at application or evaluation as written, e.g. 'V4', '20 dias após emergência'. Null for lab trials without plants.

treatment.description: Treatment name exactly as written in the table row or column header.

treatment_type.description: chemical = synthetic insecticide; biological = live organism or microbial product (Bt spray, baculovirus, fungi, parasitoids, predators); Bt = transgenic Bt maize hybrid or event; cultural = cropping practice (sowing date, desiccation, intercrop, push-pull, silicon fertilization); control = untreated check or non-Bt isoline used as check; other = botanicals (neem, plant extracts), pheromone-only, combinations that do not fit one class.

active_ingredient_or_agent.description: Active ingredient, organism or Bt protein as written in the document, e.g. 'clorpirifós', 'Telenomus remus', 'Cry1A.105 + Cry2Ab2'. Null if the document gives only a trade name.

dose_and_unit.description: Dose with unit as written, e.g. '0,2 L/ha', '15 parasitoides/m2', '5%'. Null when not applicable (Bt hybrid, control) or not stated.

application_method.description: How it was applied, as written: 'pulverização', 'via irrigação', 'tratamento de sementes', 'liberação inundativa', 'dieta artificial', 'imersão de folhas'. Null if not stated.

variable.description: Measured variable exactly as written in the table header or caption, including evaluation timing when it is part of the header, e.g. 'Mortalidade (%) 72 h', 'Nota de dano 14 DAA'.

variable_standardized.description: efficacy_pct = control efficiency as printed by the authors (Abbott, Henderson-Tilton or similar); mortality_pct = observed or corrected mortality; damage_score = leaf damage rating scale (e.g. Davis 0-9, 0-5); larvae_per_plant = larvae counts per plant or per sample unit; yield_kg_ha = grain yield printed in kg/ha; other = anything else (parasitism %, % infested plants, pupal weight, development time, yield in other units, cost).

value.description: The number from the cell, decimal point. Only change allowed vs value_as_printed: decimal comma to point and removal of thousands separators.

value_as_printed.description: The number exactly as printed in the cell, without significance letters or dispersion term, e.g. '87,5'.

unit.description: Unit as printed or stated in the caption, e.g. '%', 'kg/ha', 'lagartas/planta', 'nota (0-5)', 'mg', 'dias'.

n_or_reps.description: Replicates or sample size as stated, e.g. '4 repetições', 'n = 30 lagartas', '8 blocos'.

statistic.description: What the number is. Use 'mean' unless the document says otherwise.

significance_letter.description: Letter(s) after the value exactly as printed, e.g. 'a', 'bc', 'Ab1'. Null if none.

notes.description: Anything the checker needs: dispersion term as printed ('± 0,5'), footnote markers, the quoted sentence for 'text' values, transformation used for statistics, doubts. Never a value that should be its own record.
